payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sort heroes; for each dragon, binary search to find candidate heroes (smallest >= defense and largest < defense), then greedily choose the cheaper between sending the larger hero or upgrading the smaller one, with possible additional upgrades to defending heroes.
payload.rationale: The solution sorts the hero strengths and uses binary search to locate the optimal hero to send. It then makes a greedy decision between two adjacent heroes based on the cost to meet attack and defense requirements. This matches the greedy_sorting_order pattern.
